ns0:g.ns0:text: A well-mixed constant-volume tank responds exponentially to an inlet concentration step

ns0:text.ns0:tspan: =0; at t=0 the inlet steps to 1 mol/L. Equal constant inlet/outlet volumetric rates, constant V, complete mixing, no reaction. Outlet

ns0:g.ns0:text: concentration equals tank concentration; inlet/outlet pipe delays are neglected.
